name: BurgerMeister Grill & Go
address: 29 1st Ave, Klein Brak River, 6503, South Africa
description_short: Casual burger joint in Klein Brak River serving hearty American-style burgers and grills near the coast.
description_long:
BurgerMeister Grill & Go brings straightforward American-style burgers and grills to Klein Brak River, just off the main Garden Route corridor. The casual spot focuses on classic burger combinations and grilled fare, making it a convenient stop for a quick, satisfying meal without fuss.

Located on 1st Avenue in the quiet coastal village of Glentana, it's a handy option for travellers passing through or locals looking for an easy dinner. The relaxed atmosphere and mid-range pricing make it suitable for families and groups who want something familiar and filling. Expect honest burgers, straightforward service, and the kind of meal that hits the spot after a day exploring the coast.
